import Mathlib

theorem p04 (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (i : ℕ) = n * (n + 1) / 2 := by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_id, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.mul_comm]
